title: Hedgedoc (LinuxServer.io)
tagline: Gives you access to all your files wherever you are. Hedgedoc is a real-time, multi-platform collaborative markdown note editor. This means that you can write notes with other people on your desktop, tablet or even on the phone. You can sign-in via multiple auth providers like Facebook, Twitter, Github and many more on the homepage.
